prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Charlotte. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Charlotte for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll make a short, tailored list of specific orthodontists in Charlotte for you to call, but first I need two quick things so the recommendations match your needs:

1. Your ZIP code or neighborhood (Charlotte is big — location matters).  
2. Are you an adult or looking for a child/teen? (Different specialists and offices are better for kids.)  
3. Any insurance or budget limits? And do you prefer Invisalign specifically, or are you open to traditional braces/other options?

If you want a quick checklist now (so you can start calling immediately), here are the best types of offices to call and what to ask them — this will help you pick quickly:

Which offices to call (general guidance)
- Board-certified orthodontists (American Board of Orthodontics or AAO member). Board certification and AAO membership are strong quality signals.  
- High-level Invisalign providers (Platinum/Diamond-level if you want Invisalign) — they’ll have more experience with complex clear-aligner cases.  
- Pediatric orthodontists for kids (look for “pediatric” or specialists who advertise early-childhood care).  
- Practices that use digital scanning/3D treatment planning (faster, more comfortable impressions).  
- Offices that offer flexible payment plans and coordinate with your insurance.

What to ask when you call
- Are you a board-certified orthodontist / member of AAO?  
- How many Invisalign cases have you treated, and what is your Invisalign provider level?  
- Do you treat adults (or children) routinely?  
- Do you use iTero or other digital scans instead of impressions?  
- What is the typical treatment length and estimated cost range for Invisalign vs braces?  
- Do you offer free or low-cost consultations? Are X-rays/scans included?  
- What payment plans, down payments, and insurance support do you offer?  
- How do you handle emergencies or broken brackets/aligners outside office hours?  
- Can you show before/after photos of cases like mine?

How to choose after calls
- Get consultations (in-person or virtual) with at least 2–3 offices. Compare treatment plans, timelines, and costs.  
- Ask for patient references or look at recent online reviews and before/after galleries.  
- Prefer offices that provide a clear written estimate and digital treatment preview when possible.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code, age (adult or child), and insurance preference and I’ll find 4–6 specific orthodontists/clinics in Charlotte to call, with short notes on why each one may be a good fit. Which ZIP and age should I use?
